answer: The counter asks for Elected woodcarver licence with woodcarvers endorsement first, and a licence woodcarvers renew after gouge audits is the answer it accepts. The desk takes 2 hours at the counter for every name, counted one by one per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. violet is written on the receipt. One zephyr, one entry. The tally keeps vault.
